scope: Actual production source edits executed in fresh Interleaving proof-tail-stripped projections; full local dependency proofs retained. Finite sensitivity evidence, not proof of mutated mathematics or deployed fidelity.

variants.name: schedule-count-bypass
variants.mechanism: Accept every schedule count while preserving structural admission.

variants.name: reintroduce-overlap-rejection
variants.mechanism: After complete-count admission, reject Parallel footprint conflicts as configuration errors.

variants.name: stale-initial-world
variants.mechanism: Execute every invocation against the first actual attempt pre-world; use current world only before the first attempt.

variants.name: isolated-branch-world
variants.mechanism: Replay the selected own consumed prefix through actual Parallel.runBranch from the first pre-world, execute on its isolated world, and replace the shared world through actual Machine.accept.

variants.name: global-cancellation
variants.mechanism: Skip every subsequent token if either branch has failed, cancelling the successful peer.

variants.name: prefix-world-rollback
variants.mechanism: On a refused actual invocation, restore the full global world to the initial pre-world while retaining recorded prefix events and exact failure.

variants.name: retry-halted-suffix
variants.mechanism: Bypass the own-failure guard, permitting an actual later static slot after replenishment to execute.

variants.name: peer-history-leakage
variants.mechanism: Append peer outputs to own history used by actual executeStep; own matching keys still take precedence.

variants.name: snapshot-recomputation
variants.mechanism: Resolve every selected own snapshot component/port cell in the trusted catalog and reread its current shared balance before actual input resolution.

variants.name: global-boundary-position
variants.mechanism: Use global consumed schedule position for the trusted boundary lookup while retaining own invocation index.

variants.name: global-invocation-position
variants.mechanism: Use global consumed schedule position to select the own branch invocation; this differs from its successful index.

variants.name: drop-peer-supply
variants.mechanism: Exclude actual right-branch attempts from Machine.supply aggregation; their successful nonzero receipt contribution is lost.

variants.name: resurrect-revoked-capabilities
variants.mechanism: Mark every capability entry live in the actual execution pre-world, reactivating a revoked grant.

variants.name: omit-canonical-failure
variants.mechanism: Drop exact located failure from actual LocalState.observe used by matchesExpected, observationsEqual, and matchesParallel.

oracle_overlap.limitation: Both designated wrong-world labels fail under both variants; their designation is not independent separation.

native_review_status: Parent-managed Grok/Fable reviews; this execution result does not supply reviewer approval.
